messages:
incident-bot: PAGER ALERT -> prod/gateway: sudden spike in 5xx and 429s (severity: P1). Paging mira. Dashboard: https://metrics.redwood.internal/d/xyz/gateway-overview?orgId=1 :rotating_light:

mira: acked, oncall here. beginning triage. seeing spike at ~17:03 UTC. 5xx rate jumped from 0.3% -> ~11% in last 6m, 429s also up.

carla: I rolled a rate-limit config to prod via infra-rollouts ~9m ago (PR #8421). tagging @mira @sam - could be related.

sam: I’m pulling traces and backend logs. seeing a lot of upstream socket timeouts and 502 from runtime nodes. pattern: requests -> gateway -> rate-limiter returning 429 -> retries -> upstream saturation -> 502/504.

mira: initial hypothesis: rate-limit/quota change reduced global token-bucket capacity accidentally (bad default) causing aggressive 429s and retries which fan out and overload backend -> spike in 5xx.

rob: can we confirm the config delta quickly? carla, can you paste the changed keys?

carla: diff from previous commit:

```
- global_default_rate_per_sec: 20000
+ global_default_rate_per_sec: 2000  # unintended extra 0 removed?
- per_tenant_burst: 500
+ per_tenant_burst: 50
```

carla: yep that looks like the problem. the rollout used the new defaults. bad templating.

mira: mitigation plan (live):
1) rollback rate-limit config to previous commit (immediate).
2) temporarily raise global bucket and per-tenant burst for top-tier tenants to reduce retries.
3) open traffic split to secondary region for heavy tenants if rollback insufficient.
4) engage CS for affected customers and prepare incident comms.

rob: executing rollback now. running helm rollback of infra-rate-limiter release -> helm rollback infra-rate-limiter 12 --namespace infra-prod

infra-bot: deploy-bot: rollback job started for release infra-rate-limiter (rev 12) by rob. CI pipeline id: 981234.

mira: watching metrics: Prometheus queries (watching last 5m):
```
rate(gateway_responses_total{code=~"5.."}[1m])
rate(gateway_responses_total{code="429"}[1m])
```

sam: also patched a short-term rule to bypass rate-limiter for healthchecks and internal probe traffic: `route: /internal/* bypass_rate_limit: true`

carla: temporary per-tenant bump for tenant IDs: tenant-A, tenant-B, tenant-C via api call: `POST /admin/tenants/tenant-A/quota {"burst":500}` - applied to top 5 tenants.

mira: at 5732102482 rollback finished (helm reported SUCCESS). infra-bot shows configmap reverted to previous sha: a1b2c3d.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: rollback succeeded. 2/2 nodes reloaded.

mira: metrics update: 5xx rate fell from 11% -> 1.4% within 90s after rollback. 429 count dropped 87%. still watching for residual backpressure. :white_check_mark:

rob: quick impact summary for comms:
- window: 17:03 - 17:08 UTC
- peak affected: ~12% of total requests returned 5xx/timeout
- estimated customer impact: intermittent failures for ~7 customers (top-tier saw retry storms), automated retries amplified load
- mitigation: rollback + per-tenant emergency bump + bypass for internal probes; traffic split not needed after rollback

liaison: pinging CS and account execs now. drafting short blurb for status page (will include affected tenants list and timeline).

sam: logs snippet around peak:
```
[17:03:12] gateway request id=abc123 tenant=tenant-A -> rate-limiter: 429 (bucket=exhausted)
[17:03:12] gateway retry -> forwarded to runtime node-17 -> node-17: connection reset by peer -> 502
[17:03:13] runtime node-17 cpu spiking 98% from retry storm
```

mira: next steps:
- create a postmortem with root cause: deploy templating allowed dangerous defaults to slip into prod.
- add a pre-deploy validation to compare new rate-limit defaults against sane thresholds (block PRs with >5x reduction).
- schedule follow-up with infra to review CI gating for rate-limit changes.

rob: closing the pager: monitoring will watch for 30m. if we see re-escalation, reopen. thanks for fast responses.

mira: agreed. leaving on-call watch for 30m then handing to next oncall for follow-up items.

liaison: status page entry queued. CS will reach out to the 7 impacted customers with a heads-up and ETA for postmortem.

carla: adding reminder to PR template: require load-impact doc for rate-limit changes.

mira: marking incident as mitigated at 5732102516. will file detailed postmortem. good work team. :tada:
